description.text: Primary fact: September payrolls rose 29,000 and unemployment was 4.2%. Wage growth was 0.1% monthly / 3.0% yearly; combined July/August revisions were -60,000.

sources.label: BLS September employment
sources.limitation: Browser tool retrieved release; direct urllib download failed. Revisions can alter interpretation; no consensus surprise claimed.

description.text: Scenario inference: softer wage pressure could support financing-sensitive valuations; weak hiring could undermine sales. Disconfirmation: rising yields together with weaker issuer demand. Trigger: compare next completed sessions, issuer guidance and the services release; do not infer causality from prices alone.

Inherited secondary session account: S&P 500 gained0.7% and Nasdaq1.2% Friday; the S&P lost0.3% over the week. This account was available October3; AP direct retrieval failed today. Reported employment-driven attribution is not independent causal proof.
